contract.title: Remote formal environment activation cold review
contract.goal: Audit commit 4568e3bc22e9a44106f67c3f2119010dae63997d. Confirm the one-line activation makes remote prepare and fail handling use the same configured environment as the tmux formal child without weakening authorization, nonce, deployment, or fail-closed behavior. Challenge heredoc expansion, set -e behavior, REMOTE_PYTHON resolution, activation failure handling, and whether the new regression actually catches the incident rather than only a harmless string change. Return PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES, separating blockers from nonblocking improvements. Do not edit files or broaden scope.
acceptance: Cite exact lines for every major finding.
Trace prepare, tmux child, and fail paths separately.
Assess the test against the observed system-python incident.
State explicit verdict and open items.
